nodes.action: Inventory the relevant entrypoints, dependencies, mutable state, outputs, and explicit invariants without replacing or relocating the existing project.
inputs: Declared API, CLI, or artifact contract
nodes.name: Establish scope and baseline
preconditions: The target service or job and its existing verification surface are available
nodes.validator: The map identifies the execution entrypoint, affected downstream artifacts, and normal-versus-failure behavior that must remain distinguishable.

nodes.action: Read the supplied diagnostics and trace the affected control flow, data transformations, error handling, and shared-state access paths.
nodes.name: Collect failure evidence
nodes.validator: Each hypothesis is tied to observable evidence or a specific control-flow/state transition.

nodes.action: Exercise the smallest reproducer, then vary timing and inputs to distinguish deterministic bugs from race, validation, timeout, authorization, or fallback behavior.
inputs: Concurrent, malformed, timeout, or adversarial cases suggested by the task
nodes.name: Reproduce under stress
preconditions: The affected entrypoint can be invoked safely
nodes.validator: The observed result demonstrates the reported failure or narrows it to a falsifiable trigger while confirming at least one unaffected baseline.

nodes.action: Inspect alternate control-flow paths and boundary conditions to identify where invalid, stale, partial, or concurrently accessed data can be mistaken for valid output.
nodes.name: Analyze statically when runtime evidence is incomplete
preconditions: Relevant source and configuration are readable
nodes.validator: The candidate explains the observed artifact and predicts a concrete regression check.

nodes.action: Select the explanation that accounts for the failure, then define the invariant that must hold; preserve valid behavior and ensure failures remain observable rather than being converted into misleading success data.
nodes.name: Confirm root cause and repair invariant
preconditions: At least one evidence path from n3 or n4 is available
nodes.validator: The invariant covers the failing boundary, does not rely on hiding exceptions, and does not impose unnecessary serialization or broaden access.

nodes.action: Edit the existing implementation at the narrowest responsible boundary, using safe state coordination, strict validation, explicit failure metadata, or correct authorization/error propagation as appropriate.
nodes.name: Implement the minimal compatible fix
preconditions: A confirmed root cause and repair invariant exist
nodes.validator: The patch leaves normal outputs compatible, handles the failing case explicitly, and avoids catch-and-ignore behavior or excessive global locking.

nodes.action: Run focused checks covering successful behavior, invalid inputs, failure reporting, security boundaries, repeated requests, and output persistence; inspect status codes, fields, logs, and process results.
inputs: Expected response, report, or artifact schema
nodes.name: Validate contracts and regressions
nodes.validator: Success cases retain required fields and values; failure cases have non-success status or explicit non-healthy status, diagnostics, and no leaked or fabricated data.

nodes.action: Repeat the relevant workload under contention and adverse timing, compare latency and duplication behavior with the baseline, and review the final diff for scope, portability, and accidental artifacts.
nodes.name: Stress-test and finalize
nodes.validator: Concurrent requests or parallel sources complete without races or false success; valid work remains reasonably responsive; only in-scope existing project files are changed.

nodes.action: Extract normal-path invariants, failure-path expectations, safety constraints, and explicitly prohibited shortcuts into a verification checklist.
inputs: Declared API, CLI, or output contract
nodes.name: Define_contract_and_failure_surface
preconditions: The task identifies an existing service or job and expected behavior.
nodes.validator: Checklist covers successful behavior, representative invalid or failed inputs, relevant concurrency or timing conditions, and required artifact location.

nodes.action: Trace the relevant execution paths and shared state, inspect error conversion and fallback logic, and identify suspicious assumptions without changing files.
inputs: Adjacent types, configuration, and call sites
nodes.name: Inspect_targeted_evidence
preconditions: n1 has produced a scope and failure checklist.
nodes.validator: Each hypothesis is tied to a concrete code path or observed diagnostic and distinguishes symptoms from possible causes.

nodes.action: Run focused reproductions across normal, boundary, and failure conditions; capture status, output shape, logs, timing, and state transitions.
inputs: Stress, timeout, malformed, or authorization variants as applicable
nodes.name: Reproduce_under_representative_conditions
preconditions: n2 has identified executable paths or test entry points.
nodes.validator: The reproducer demonstrates the reported defect or a deterministic equivalent, while the baseline confirms unaffected behavior that must remain stable.

nodes.action: Locate the earliest violated invariant, choose the smallest existing-code change that restores it, and define explicit handling for rejected, timed-out, malformed, or competing operations instead of masking errors.
nodes.name: Select_invariant_preserving_fix
preconditions: n3 provides an observed failure signature.
n2 provides at least one code-level hypothesis.
nodes.validator: The design explains why the failure occurs, preserves the public contract, and does not rely on swallowing exceptions, unsafe fallback values, or excessive serialization.

nodes.action: Edit the existing implementation in place, keeping interfaces and successful results compatible while making shared-state transitions, validation, error propagation, and diagnostics explicit and safe.
nodes.name: Implement_scoped_patch
preconditions: n4 has selected a fix boundary and validation cases.
nodes.validator: Only in-scope existing files are changed; the patch addresses the identified invariant and leaves no placeholder, stub, or unconditional success path.

nodes.action: Validate successful behavior and failure semantics separately, including repeated or overlapping operations, malformed inputs, partial upstream failures, authorization boundaries, output persistence, and diagnostic visibility as applicable.
inputs: Concurrency or timing cases when relevant
nodes.name: Exercise_failure_aware_validation
nodes.validator: Valid cases retain required status, fields, and values; invalid or failed cases return explicit non-success states with no misleading data leakage or false healthy defaults; concurrent execution remains correct.

nodes.action: Review the patch for hidden exception suppression, accidental contract changes, race-prone state, over-broad access, misleading fallback values, unnecessary bottlenecks, and edits outside the requested workspace.
nodes.name: Review_regression_and_scope
preconditions: n6 has completed the validation matrix.
nodes.validator: All required checks pass, the diff is narrowly scoped, and any unresolved limitation is explicit rather than represented as success.
